moduleTitle: Theme 2: Popular culture — Customs, festivals and celebrations

note.specFocus: French and francophone festivals and traditions (Christmas, New Year, Bastille Day, religious and cultural celebrations), family customs, and describing celebrations in the past and future.
note.sourcePages: Written to match the AQA GCSE French (8652) specification; no supplied booklet for this subject.
note.summary:
2.2 Customs, festivals and celebrations
Key vocabulary
- une fête/un festival = a celebration/festival; Noël/le Nouvel An = Christmas/New Year
- la fête nationale (le 14 juillet) = Bastille Day; un anniversaire = a birthday
- les traditions/les coutumes = traditions/customs; un cadeau = a present
- un repas de fête = a festive meal; se réunir en famille = to get together as a family
- les feux d'artifice = fireworks; fêter/célébrer = to celebrate; défiler = to parade

Key grammar
- Perfect tense for describing past celebrations: on a fêté, j'ai reçu des cadeaux, nous sommes allés au défilé.
- Near future for upcoming celebrations: on va fêter, je vais inviter.
- Impersonal expressions: il y a un défilé, c'est l'occasion de...
- Time expressions for traditions: chaque année, chaque 14 juillet, chaque Noël.

Exam tips
- Festivals are a rich topic for the perfect tense — revise irregular past participles (reçu, vu, fait) as they appear often.
- Compare a French festival with one from your own culture to show range of language in speaking/writing.
- In reading/listening, dates and numbers (le 14 juillet, à minuit) are common and worth learning precisely.

questions.examTip: Underline key nouns, verbs and negatives in the transcript first, then match each English question to the matching French sentence before answering — don't translate word-for-word.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. Its national day/Bastille Day ("sa fête nationale").
2. Went to see the military parade with their family ("je suis allé voir le défilé militaire avec ma famille").
3. Watched the fireworks near the river ("nous avons regardé les feux d'artifice près de la rivière").
4. Ate an ice cream together ("nous avons mangé une glace ensemble").
5. Because it brings people together and celebrates the country's history ("elle rassemble les gens et célèbre l'histoire du pays").
questions.question:
Listening-style written practice (read the transcript — there is no audio in this app):

"Chaque année, le 14 juillet, la France célèbre sa fête nationale. L'année dernière, je suis allé voir le défilé militaire avec ma famille, puis le soir, nous avons regardé les feux d'artifice près de la rivière. C'était magnifique ! Après, nous avons mangé une glace ensemble. Je trouve que cette fête est importante parce qu'elle rassemble les gens et célèbre l'histoire du pays."

Answer in English:
1. What does France celebrate every year on 14 July?
2. What did the speaker do last year during the day?
3. What did they do in the evening?
4. What did they do after the fireworks?
5. Why does the speaker think this festival is important?

questions.examTip: Underline key nouns, verbs and negatives in the transcript first, then match each English question to the matching French sentence before answering — don't translate word-for-word.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. Christmas ("Noël est la fête la plus importante").
2. At their grandparents' house, on 24 December ("chez mes grands-parents le 24 décembre").
3. Turkey and chestnuts ("de la dinde et des marrons").
4. Open the presents together ("on ouvre les cadeaux ensemble").
5. To invite their cousins from Spain, because they have never spent Christmas in France ("ils n'ont jamais passé Noël en France").
questions.question:
Listening-style written practice (read the transcript — there is no audio in this app):

"Dans ma famille, Noël est la fête la plus importante de l'année. On se réunit toujours chez mes grands-parents le 24 décembre pour un grand repas de fête avec de la dinde et des marrons. À minuit, on ouvre les cadeaux ensemble. L'année prochaine, je vais inviter aussi mes cousins d'Espagne parce qu'ils n'ont jamais passé Noël en France."

Answer in English:
1. Which celebration is the most important in the speaker's family?
2. Where do they always gather, and when?
3. What do they eat at the festive meal?
4. What do they do at midnight?
5. What is the speaker planning for next year, and why?

Listening-style written practice. Read: « Chaque année, ma famille fête Noël ensemble. L'année dernière, nous avons participé au carnaval de notre ville. Pour le prochain anniversaire de ma mère, je préparerai un gâteau. »

Answer in English: (1) What is the present habit, situation or opinion? (2) What happened in the past? (3) What is planned or recommended for the future?
questions.modelAnswer: Every year, my family celebrates Christmas together. Last year, we took part in our town's carnival. For my mother's next birthday, I will make a cake.
questions.examTip: Use exact evidence, varied time frames and justified opinions; check negative wording and verb accuracy.

For each statement write V, F or N (not mentioned).
1. A present activity or opinion is given.
2. Something happened in the past.
3. No future idea is mentioned.
4. A detailed justification is always given.
